                    Receiving Desk.

                    Development Office detailing the complaint

complaint?          gathered and encoded every other day in a week
                    and summarized into a Customer/Client’s

                    analyzes the report to act on complaints (if any).
                    Accomplish the Feedback & Complaint Form and
                    drop at the designated box on the Receiving Desk.
